correctness.independent_verification: Two independent partition enumeration formulations and exact envelope checking corroborate the finite threshold. The balancing and majorization arguments justify that the finite loop excludes every eligible profile at N<=14; no inference about larger-N impossibility is made.
correctness.rationale: For profiles of common total N, D0=r, D2=N^2/S with S=sum a_i^2 and D∞=N/x with x=maximum count, so oriented desired triple reversal is exactly r_A<r_B, x_A>x_B, S_A<S_B. Fix N, r_A=r, x_A=x. Discrete smoothing minimizes S_A among r-part profiles with maximum x at L=x²+(r-1-u)t²+u(t+1)² (N-x=(r-1)t+u). For B all parts at most x-1, number at least s=max(r+1,ceil(N/(x-1))); capped greedy filling of s positive parts majorizes all feasible B and supplies the exact upper bound U. Every witness must satisfy L<U. Independent exact arithmetic traversing all 1<=N<=14, 2<=r<N, 2<=x<=N-r+1 found precisely (N,r,x,s,L,U)=(14,5,6,6,52,54); separate enumeration of 20,283 unordered partition pairs found no witness before 14 and only A=(6,2,2,2,2), B=(5,5,1,1,1,1) at 14. Because S congruent N mod2, strict inequality within [52,54] forces S(A)=52 and S(B)=54; strict convexity/majorization characterize the unique extremal profiles. Calculated indices D2=49/13 versus 98/27 and D∞=7/3 versus 14/5. The claimed cutoff is for the specified equal-total order triple (0,2,∞), not all Hill profile crossings.

value.rationale: The three orders 0,2,∞ are canonical ecological diversity measures: richness, inverse Simpson and dominance. Establishing a sharp census threshold for an intermediate rank reversal, with uniqueness and exact rational diversities, supplies a motivated finite structural boundary for diversity-index selection, not an arbitrary partition tuple. Does not suggest policy prescriptions or generalized all-order profile classification.
